source_lock.table_selection: derived plus files with .csv or .parquet suffix; retained ZIP is provenance, not a separate table
source_lock.provenance: Lock sources and index_provenance carry publisher, citation, CC-BY-4.0 license, URLs and acquisition metadata; preserve attribution. UWF hashes are locally observed, not publisher-certified.

source_identity_rule: Each observations.profiles entry records path, source_sha256 and source_bytes verified against source_lock. These referenced pins, not filenames alone, identify membership.

measured_population.scope: Exact traversed row counts and label aggregates; totals include duplicates and overlapping exports. Not independent cases or incident counts.

development_membership.selection: For every observations.profiles entry, development_membership.row_ordinals is the exact union of prefix and seeded non-prefix membership; one-based parsed data records, headers excluded.
development_membership.csv_method: Algorithm R reservoir over all records; bounded selected-row memory
development_membership.parquet_method: Seeded uniform ordinal selection using metadata, followed by bounded batch traversal and exact metadata/stream count comparison
development_membership.previous_disclosure: All first 2000 records of the six CSVs inspected in data-understanding-01 and -02 remain development; included in this union. Other undocumented historical disclosures are unknown and require reconciliation before freeze.
development_membership.population_disclosure: Full-population label aggregates were inspected for every table. Individual non-selected labeled rows were not emitted or inspected by an agent here; statistics are nevertheless development-informed.
development_membership.rare_week: All 63 records in UWF 2022-02-13 - 2022-02-20 are development; none may be relabeled held-out.
development_membership.candidate_disclosure: No fresh candidate ran in this checkpoint. Candidate dispatch remains blocked by absent runSubagent/tool_search capabilities.
development_membership.held_out_status: No untouched evaluation cohort certified. Exclude inspected records AND all linked duplicate/connection groups before proposing future evaluation membership.

hikari.proposed_binary_mapping: Label 1 attack, Label 0 non-attack, supported by inspected joint category counts; publisher meaning and full-population joint consistency still require semantic review.
hikari.shortcut: traffic_category and Label are mutually revealing in inspected rows. Exclude both from detector inputs, along with empty-name and Unnamed: 0 export indexes.

uwf.observed_none_semantics: unknown; absence of tactic annotation is not verified benign ground truth
uwf.parquet_week_support: First six acquired weeks contain only none; 2022-02-06 - 2022-02-13 contains Reconnaissance 9278720 and Discovery 2086; final week has 63 records across nine tactics.
uwf.restriction: No full-taxonomy generalization claim. Rare week is entirely disclosed, singleton classes cannot support independent train/test estimates, and none cannot establish false-positive rate until adjudicated.

overlap.scope: Exact selected-row equality only, including export indexes and labels; sorted complete schema and typed values, CSV lexical strings and native Parquet scalars, no coercion or cross-format field mapping.
overlap.diagnostic_split_rule: Source ordinal modulo 5 equals 0 for diagnostic test side, otherwise train; no actual evaluation split created.
overlap.additional_view: observations.selected_feature_overlap excludes detected label columns but retains export indexes; not a canonical flow identity.
overlap.cross_format_overlap: unknown; CSV/Parquet schema and type differences prevent direct equality. Zero cross-format matches does not prove disjoint sources.

time_and_entities.scope: Checks cover selected development rows only; all ranges are sample ranges unless an entire small table was selected.
time_and_entities.hikari: uid, originh and responh are observed identifier candidates. flow_duration is numeric, units unknown; no absolute event timestamp identified. Do not fabricate alert clock time or temporal holdout.
time_and_entities.uwf: ts parses plausibly as epoch seconds in 2021-2022; alternative microsecond interpretation produces 1970. Operational meaning, units and timezone still need source/SME confirmation.
time_and_entities.calendar_conflict: First six Parquet weeks have naive datetime approximately 21600 seconds behind ts when interpreted as UTC; attack weeks are near agreement. CSV calendar strings are timezone-aware but contain both offset patterns. Rounding differences reach 0.001 seconds. Do not silently merge clocks.
time_and_entities.entity_limits: Connection/host candidates are not incident IDs, verified asset identities or proof of maliciousness. Grouping and identity reuse across files remain to be resolved.

proposed_splits.hikari: Evaluate supported attack-flow decisions per dataset after grouping canonical label-free/index-free duplicate rows and connection identities. Exclude development-group closure. Check class support before choosing group-stratified held-out proportions; no temporal claim without event timestamps.
proposed_splits.uwf: Do not use random rows or raw filename/week splits. First resolve schema aliases, numeric/null/time normalization and cross-format duplicate groups; keep group closure in one partition. Separate common-tactic development from rare-tactic descriptive cases. Chronological generalization is not supported by these class-segregated weeks alone.
proposed_splits.feature_policy: Exclude label annotations and export indexes. Treat UID, community ID, IPs, timestamp, calendar and source/week identity as provenance or explicit ablation risks, not unquestioned predictive features.
required_before_ready: Exact evaluator-owned untouched membership and labels
Population duplicate-group and cross-format overlap closure
Equivalent mission variants and frozen evaluator/criteria
Fresh candidate dispatch/read-back and verified restoration

proposed_metrics.status: existing constitution metric definitions unchanged; evaluator/targets/repeats remain null
proposed_metrics.cyber: Per-dataset attack recall, alert precision, adjudicated-benign false-positive rate, class support/recall, decision coverage, persisted read-back latency. Count abstentions, failures and timeouts; no incident-recall claim.
proposed_metrics.delivery: Time-to-valid evidence handoff and eventual constitutional live acceptance, observed actions by actor/type, failed attempts, unplanned human rescue, acceptance and fresh-session replication. Keep tool construction separate from paired mission effort.
proposed_metrics.proposed_quality_gate: Report prefix versus non-prefix coverage, group leakage and time uncertainty; refuse unsupported benign/incident/held-out claims. Independent evaluator applies frozen rubric before trials.

limitations: Exploration only; no detector trained or evaluated
No measured v1.6 overseer baseline or v1.7 performance result
Actual candidate/model effort, tokens and cost unknown
No cloud, external attacks or remediation
No evidence that remaining undisclosed row identities are independent of development groups
